name: Bea-Kid's Niji no Kakehashi
source:
It is an original cat-eared fantasy visual novel based on the Bea-kid's TTRPG.

A serious, slapstick, and romantic comedy story unfolds with
an unconventional party of beastmen and humans (which is very difficult to assemble according to the original TTRPG's rules).
